a_wpa_manifest.2: World Protocol Academy is an independent digital educational, research and authorial platform for protocol, diplomacy, security studies, institutional communication, public presence and professional readiness, operating in a development, testing and pilot phase — 2026.
a_wpa_manifest.3: WPA develops structured learning, practical tasks, scenario-based work, research and measurable methods while keeping claims proportionate to evidence and current institutional status.
a_wpa_manifest.4: WPA does not present itself as a university, state academy, accreditation body or degree-granting institution. Its educational, research and authorial work remains within the boundaries stated in the current public governance record.
a_wpa_manifest.5: Within WPA, protocol is treated not merely as ceremony, but as order, readiness, institutional intelligence, communication discipline and credible public representation.
a_wpa_manifest.6: World Protocol Academy is building a contemporary, internationally oriented and evidence-disciplined platform with clear human authority and institutional boundaries.

The human decides. AI may prepare.
